race.comment: SEMANTICS (14) resumes having been well backed on debut at Sandown Hillside in a handy 2yo race, boxing on well for a narrow third. Since trialled nicely and looks ready to go first up. KEEN OBSERVER (10) has placed in all four runs to date, hard in the market each time. Been a bit costly but a win looks close. HE'S A DANDY (18) didn't fire in three runs in Hong Kong but comes here with the Hayes yard and has won a jumpout nicely, very wary. LUSCOMBE (8) returns from a spell. Ran sixth in latest jump-out at Mornington. Raced just once to date and finished third at Sandown-Hillside over 1200m. Can improve
